---
applyTo: "src/services/**"
description: "Generated openapi-fetch client: services/openapi/schema.d.ts comes from the backend openapi/harbor-api.yaml (npm run generate:api); the sessionHeader() helper for /session/** calls lives in services/api/client.ts."
---
# API client (`src/services/**`)

- `src/services/openapi/schema.d.ts` is generated by `npm run generate:api` (openapi-typescript) from the backend
  `core/src/main/resources/openapi/harbor-api.yaml` (published copy: `harbor-docs/generated/openapi/backend.yaml`). Never edit it;
  never read it to answer a question (it is excluded from the generators and from Copilot); import it only from
  `src/services/api` and `src/types/*.ts`.
- A missing path or field means the backend contract has to change first; do not patch the types locally.
- `src/services/api/client.ts` creates the single `api = createClient<paths>({ baseUrl: '/api/v1' })` and exports `sessionHeader()`,
  which returns `{ 'X-Harbor-Session': sessionId }` from `src/services/api/sessionStore.ts`. The contract declares that header
  required on every `/session/**` operation, so each session-scoped hook passes `params: { header: sessionHeader(), ... }`;
  there is no middleware and no other place builds this header.
- `sessionStore.ts` is the only owner of the current `sessionId`; it is set when a session is created or selected and cleared on close.
- Error handling: `api.*` returns `{ data, error, response }`; hooks surface `error` to react-query, components never inspect `response`.
- Keep this folder free of page logic; no business constants, no formatting.
